narrative.lesson: Every month in this decade is a real month from 1953-2020; only the sequence is new. What a bad YEAR cannot teach - the slow grind of a decade that never lets you back to even - this shape exists to teach.
narrative.summary: A DECLARED STRESS SCENARIO compiled by bootstrap-stratified: real 1953-2020 months, entered at severity-tilted percentiles per the declared x_stress rule - a 21-month worst-decile crisis and a worst-third squeeze covering every other quarter, with NO declared recovery. Precedent cited inline: 1973-74, 2007-09, 2022, US 1966-1982 in real terms, Japan 1990-2003. The persistence shape is the D-SC-1 ruling (P1 re-entry + P2 declared coverage). Severe and internally coherent by construction; not a probability-weighted forecast. This is the ER-14 successor of the retired 703 campaign record: same declared scenario, rebuilt under the release engine after 703 was permanently retired (D-ER14-2) rather than renumbered in place.
